summary: Iteration 7: Verified username login + guru extra_duties RBAC + admin user CRUD. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (admin login by username & email, guru login by email, invalid creds -> 401 with 'Username/email atau password salah', create guru with username+duties, username too-short/space rejected 400, duplicate username 400, PUT /api/users/{id} updates username & duties, RBAC gating for guru[tabungan,tartil]: savings 200 / tahfidz 403 / attendance manual tartil 200 / pramuka 403 / datang 200, admin bypasses all, change-password 403 for guru & siswa 400 for wrong-old admin, regression list students & attendance recap). Frontend: wrong creds error message shown, admin login via username 'admin' at /login works, /akun 'add-user-btn' + form-user-username/email/password/name + duty picker for tabungan/tahfidz saves new guru account which then logs in via username, guru sidebar shows only Tabungan + Program Tahfidz (no Ekstra Tartil/Pramuka) matching duties, guru sidebar does NOT show 'Ubah Password'. Cleanup of test user succeeded via DELETE /api/users/{id}.

minor.issue: Original sparse=True on email/username did not exclude documents with explicit null. Second user without email caused DuplicateKeyError on email:null. Fixed by switching to partialFilterExpression {email:{$type:'string'}}. Existing index drop added for username as well so it re-creates as partial.

action_items: Consider persisting the seed.py index fix (already applied) - drop old sparse email_1/username_1 and use partialFilterExpression so email:null (from create_user when email is None) does not collide.
Prior code-review carry-over from iteration 6: routes_attendance default type='kehadiran' in Pydantic models is stale.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.ensure_indexes used sparse=True but backend inserts email:null explicitly, so sparse doesn't skip -> duplicate key on 2nd null. Now using partialFilterExpression $type:'string' (fixed).

auth.login lockout uses same locked_until on every failed attempt (upsert $set overwrites), so window can never expire while attacker keeps trying with fresh identifier variation. Acceptable but consider only setting locked_until when count crosses threshold.
routes_master.create_user does not enforce password minimum length; frontend save-user-btn only requires non-empty. Consider min length 6 to align with reset-password expectations.
routes_master.update_user allows setting email='' -> None but does not validate email format; low priority.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration7.py covers username login, RBAC duty gating (savings/tahfidz/attendance manual), change-password gating, admin user CRUD (create/update/duplicate/validation). Payload field names to remember: /api/savings uses 'kind' (setoran/penarikan) not 'type'; /api/tahfidz uses ayat_from/ayat_to not ayat_dari/ayat_sampai. Seed indexes now use partialFilterExpression - startup will drop old sparse indexes and recreate.
rca of the issue: Duplicate key on E11000 email:null for 2nd user without email: MongoDB sparse indexes only skip documents where the indexed field is *missing*, not where the value is explicitly null. Backend inserts email:None (JSON null). Fix: partialFilterExpression restricting the unique constraint to documents where email is a string. Same reasoning applied preventively to username.
